peg.nav_basis_note: Theo discloses no thUSD NAV oracle, so the reference is a $1.00 assumption. This deviation is market-vs-par, NOT market-vs-redemption.

sthusd_nav_integrity.note: Quoted convertToAssets vs totalAssets/totalSupply recomputed. Agreement is evidence; divergence would mean the vault's own accounting disagrees with its share price.

peg.history_note: Peg marks are persisted into thusd_coverage_history.json on 116 of 2200 rows (5.3%). The gate needs 48 rows AND 60% coverage, so no history_field is declared — a sparse series renders as a broken chart rather than an absent one. TO ESTABLISH IT: the coverage file retains ~90 days of hourly rows and marks began 2026-08-27, so the ratio rises on its own as unmarked rows age out; no code change is needed, only time.

liquidity.total_2pct_depth_note: No exit ladder is quoted for thUSD; depth is unmeasured rather than zero. TVL is not depth and is not substituted for it. TO ESTABLISH IT: a KyberSwap or Curve get_dy ladder against the venue thUSD actually trades on, the same shape already used for USDat and sUSDai. The blocker is venue selection rather than tooling — thUSD's liquidity is split across Ethereum, Arbitrum and Stable, so a single-venue ladder would understate depth and a summed one would assume cross-chain fungibility that the bridge cadence does not guarantee.

venues.note: Arbitrum OFT-mirror dust only (~$30K, ≈$0 volume). Headline peg is `dex_peg` (Ethereum-primary combined). Retained for back-compat.

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Deliberately null. Total backing is NOT OBSERVABLE: only the on-chain reserve Safe can be read, and >30% of supply is backed off-chain where this repo has no evidence at all. A ratio computed from the observable part would report 42.84% coverage as though it were the whole answer. Use backing.on_chain_coverage_pct, which measures what can actually be seen, and note it is a FRACTION.

backing.off_chain_backing_note: RESIDUAL: circulating supply minus on-chain reserves. Ties by construction and is NOT evidence the off-chain backing exists. That >30% of supply lands here is the finding, not a reassurance.
